question: What are the admission requirements?
answer: Admission requires a completed application form; official transcripts from your previous institution; standardized test scores (SAT/ACT for undergraduate or GRE/GMAT for graduate programs); two letters of recommendation; a personal statement; and a non-refundable application fee of $50. International students must also submit TOEFL/IELTS scores.

question: What courses are offered in the Computer Science department?
answer: The CS department offers a comprehensive curriculum including Introduction to Programming; Data Structures & Algorithms; Database Systems; Operating Systems; Computer Networks; Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning; Software Engineering; Cybersecurity; Cloud Computing; and capstone project courses. Both B.Sc. and M.Sc. programs are available.

question: How do I apply for a scholarship?
answer: Scholarships are awarded based on academic merit; financial need; and extracurricular involvement. Apply through the Student Financial Aid portal by March 15 each year. Required documents include your transcript; a 500-word essay; income verification; and two faculty recommendations. Results are announced by May 1.

question: What is the fee structure for undergraduate programs?
answer: Tuition for undergraduate programs is $8;500 per semester for in-state students and $16;200 for out-of-state students. This includes tuition; library access; lab fees; and campus Wi-Fi. Hostel accommodation is an additional $2;800 per semester. Payment plans and EMI options are available through the bursar's office.

question: What are the hostel facilities like?
answer: The campus offers four residential halls with single; double; and triple occupancy rooms. All rooms include air conditioning; high-speed Wi-Fi; study desks; and wardrobe storage. Common amenities include a 24/7 laundry room; shared kitchen; recreation lounge with TV; and a quiet study area. An RA is available on each floor.

question: When is the exam schedule released?
answer: The exam schedule is published on the academic portal six weeks before finals week. Mid-term exams are typically held in weeks 7-8 of each semester; and final exams in weeks 15-16. Students can view their personalized timetable under the 'Examinations' tab. Supplementary exam dates are announced separately.

question: How does the campus placement process work?
answer: The Training & Placement Cell coordinates campus recruitment starting in the 7th semester. Over 120 companies visit annually; including Google; Microsoft; Infosys; and TCS. Students must maintain a minimum 6.5 CGPA and clear an aptitude pre-screening. The placement rate for the last batch was 92% with an average package of $72;000/year.

question: What library resources are available?
answer: The central library has over 150;000 physical volumes and access to 50+ digital databases including IEEE Xplore; ACM Digital Library; Springer; and JSTOR. Operating hours are 8 AM to midnight on weekdays and 9 AM to 9 PM on weekends. Students can borrow up to 6 books for 14 days with online renewal.

question: How do I contact the student support center?
answer: The Student Support Center is located in Building C; Room 105. Office hours are Monday to Friday; 9 AM to 5 PM. You can also email support@university.edu or call (555) 123-4567. For urgent matters outside office hours; contact the campus helpline at (555) 999-0000.

question: What extracurricular clubs are available?
answer: The campus hosts 40+ student clubs including Coding Club; Robotics Society; Debate Team; Photography Club; Music Society; Drama Club; Sports Council; Entrepreneurship Cell; Volunteer Corps; and the Student Government Association. Club fair is held during orientation week each semester.

question: What is the company's leave policy?
answer: Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days; 10 sick days; and 3 personal days per year. Vacation days accrue monthly and can carry over up to 5 days to the next year. Sick leave requires a medical certificate for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Leave requests should be submitted via the HR portal at least 2 weeks in advance for planned leave.

question: How does the payroll cycle work?
answer: Payroll is processed on the 25th of each month with direct deposit to your registered bank account by the last business day. Pay stubs are available on the HR portal under 'My Compensation.' Any discrepancies should be reported within 5 business days. Bonus payouts are processed separately in March and September.

question: What does the onboarding process include?
answer: New employee onboarding is a 5-day program covering: Day 1 — welcome orientation and ID issuance; Day 2 — IT setup and system access; Day 3 — department introduction and buddy assignment; Day 4 — compliance and policy training; Day 5 — role-specific training with your manager. All onboarding materials are available on the company intranet.

question: What health benefits does the company offer?
answer: We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical; dental; and vision insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield. Coverage starts from your first day. The company covers 80% of premiums for employees and 50% for dependents. Additional benefits include a $500 annual wellness stipend; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and gym membership discounts.

question: What is the work-from-home policy?
answer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10 AM to 3 PM in your local time zone. A $500 one-time home office setup allowance is provided. Fully remote arrangements require VP-level approval and are reviewed quarterly. VPN access is mandatory for all remote work.

question: How does the performance appraisal process work?
answer: Performance reviews are conducted bi-annually in June and December. The process includes self-assessment; peer feedback (360-degree); and a manager evaluation. Goals are set using the OKR framework at the start of each cycle. Ratings directly influence merit raises (2-8%) and promotion eligibility. Review meetings are scheduled over a 2-week window.

question: What is the resignation and notice period policy?
answer: The standard notice period is 30 days for individual contributors and 60 days for managers and above. Resignation should be submitted through the HR portal with a copy to your direct manager. Exit interviews are conducted during the last week. Early release may be granted at the company's discretion with a buyout option.

question: How do I submit an expense reimbursement?
answer: Submit expense claims through the HR portal under 'Expense Management' within 30 days of the expense. Attach original receipts or scanned copies. Categories include travel; meals; client entertainment; and professional development. Claims under $500 are auto-approved by your manager; above $500 requires finance team approval. Reimbursement is processed within 10 business days.

question: What training and development programs are available?
answer: We offer LinkedIn Learning access for all employees; quarterly skill workshops; an annual conference attendance budget of $2;000; tuition reimbursement up to $5;250/year for approved courses; internal mentorship programs; and leadership development tracks. Discuss your development plan with your manager during performance reviews.

question: How do I report a workplace concern or grievance?
answer: Workplace concerns can be reported through the anonymous Ethics Hotline at 1-800-555-ETHIC; via email to ethics@company.com; or directly to your HR Business Partner. All reports are investigated within 10 business days. The company maintains a strict non-retaliation policy. For urgent safety concerns; contact Security at ext. 911.

question: How do I track my order?
answer: Log into your account and go to 'My Orders' to view real-time tracking information. You'll see the current status (Processing; Shipped; Out for Delivery; or Delivered) along with the carrier tracking number. You can also track via the link in your shipping confirmation email. For phone orders; call us at 1-800-555-SHOP with your order number.

question: What is the return and refund policy?
answer: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original packaging and unused condition. Initiate a return from 'My Orders' > 'Return Item.' Free return shipping labels are provided for defective items. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method. Gift cards and personalized items are non-returnable.

question: I'm having a payment issue. What should I do?
answer: Common payment issues include declined cards; double charges; and pending transactions. First; verify your card details and available balance. For declined transactions; try a different payment method or contact your bank. Double charges are usually authorization holds that clear within 48 hours. For persistent issues; contact our billing team at billing@store.com.

question: How do I change or cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of placement through 'My Orders' > 'Modify/Cancel.' Once the order enters processing (usually within 2 hours); cancellation is no longer possible and you'll need to initiate a return after delivery. For subscription orders; changes must be made 48 hours before the next billing date.

question: What shipping options are available?
answer: We offer Standard Shipping (5-7 business days; free over $50); Express Shipping (2-3 business days; $9.99); and Next-Day Delivery ($19.99; order by 2 PM). International shipping is available to 40+ countries with delivery in 10-15 business days. During peak seasons; add 1-2 days to estimated delivery times.

question: How do I create or manage my account?
answer: Create an account at our website by clicking 'Sign Up' and providing your email; name; and password. To manage your account; go to 'Account Settings' where you can update your profile; change password; manage addresses; update payment methods; and set communication preferences. To delete your account; contact support.

question: How do I apply a promo code or coupon?
answer: Enter your promo code in the 'Discount Code' field on the checkout page and click 'Apply.' Only one promo code can be used per order. Codes are case-sensitive and may have minimum purchase requirements or expiration dates. If your code isn't working; check the terms or contact support with the code details.

question: What warranty coverage do my products have?
answer: Most products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. Extended warranty plans (2 or 3 years) can be purchased within 30 days of your original purchase. Warranty claims require proof of purchase. Physical damage; misuse; and unauthorized modifications are not covered.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Reach us via Live Chat (24/7) on our website; email at help@store.com (response within 4 hours); or phone at 1-800-555-HELP (Mon-Fri 8AM-8PM; Sat-Sun 10AM-6PM EST). For social media inquiries; DM us on Twitter @StoreSupport or Facebook. Priority support is available for Premium members.

question: How do I leave a product review?
answer: After your order is delivered; you'll receive a review invitation email within 7 days. You can also go to the product page and click 'Write a Review.' Include a star rating (1-5); written review; and optional photos. Verified purchase reviews are highlighted. Reviews are moderated and published within 24 hours.

question: How do I set up the product for the first time?
answer: Unbox and connect the power adapter. Press and hold the power button for 3 seconds until the LED turns blue. Download our companion app (iOS/Android) and follow the on-screen setup wizard. Connect to your Wi-Fi network when prompted. The initial setup takes approximately 5 minutes. A quick-start guide is included in the box.

question: The device is not turning on. How do I fix it?
answer: First; ensure the power adapter is firmly connected and the outlet is working. Try a different power cable if available. Perform a hard reset by holding the power button for 15 seconds. If the LED doesn't respond; try charging for at least 30 minutes before powering on. If the issue persists; the device may need service — contact support.

question: How do I connect the product to Wi-Fi?
answer: Go to Settings > Network > Wi-Fi in the device menu or companion app. Select your network from the list and enter the password. The device supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz networks. If connection fails; move closer to the router; restart the device; and ensure your router firmware is up to date. WPA2/WPA3 security is required.

question: How do I update the firmware/software?
answer: Updates are delivered automatically when connected to Wi-Fi. To check manually; go to Settings > System > Software Update. The current version is displayed along with any available updates. Updates typically take 5-10 minutes. Do not power off the device during an update. Release notes are available on our support page.

question: What are the product specifications?
answer: Processor: Quad-core ARM Cortex-A73 @ 2.0GHz. Memory: 4GB LPDDR4X RAM; 64GB internal storage. Display: 7-inch IPS LCD; 1920x1200 resolution. Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax); Bluetooth 5.2; USB-C 3.1. Battery: 5000mAh; up to 10 hours usage. Dimensions: 194 x 120 x 8.5mm. Weight: 320g. Colors: Midnight Black; Silver Frost.

question: Can I use the product with other smart home devices?
answer: Yes! The product is compatible with Amazon Alexa; Google Home; Apple HomeKit; and Samsung SmartThings. Enable the integration through your smart home app by searching for our product skill/service. IFTTT applets are also supported for custom automations. Ensure all devices are on the same network for seamless connectivity.

question: How do I reset the device to factory settings?
answer: Go to Settings > System > Factory Reset; or press and hold the Power + Volume Down buttons simultaneously for 10 seconds until the LED flashes red. This erases all personal data; settings; and accounts. The device will restart in its out-of-box state. Back up important data before resetting. This action cannot be undone.

question: How do I submit a feature request?
answer: We love hearing from users! Submit feature requests through the companion app under Help > Feature Request; or email features@product.com. You can also vote on existing requests in our Community Forum at community.product.com. Top-voted features are reviewed quarterly by our product team and included in the roadmap when feasible.

question: What accessories are available for this product?
answer: Available accessories include: Protective Case ($29.99); Wireless Charging Pad ($39.99); Bluetooth Keyboard ($49.99); Stylus Pen ($34.99); Screen Protector 2-Pack ($14.99); USB-C Hub ($44.99); and Travel Pouch ($19.99). All accessories are available on our website and authorized retailers. Bundle discounts of 15% apply when purchasing 3+ accessories.

question: Where can I find the user manual and documentation?
answer: The complete user manual is available as a PDF download at support.product.com/manuals. In-app help is accessible via Settings > Help & Support. Video tutorials are available on our YouTube channel @ProductHelp. The Community Forum at community.product.com has user guides; tips; and troubleshooting articles contributed by staff and users.
